## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who returned to the classroom after a period of separation from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). During the following October term, Julia participated in a school reciter's group organized by their teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), in preparation for a Christmas concert.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
